gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Every stroke in Oxanium has the same rope-like consistency. Noto Sans Georgian follows with open curves and short ascenders on tall lowercase bodies, so paragraphs run along smoothly without any fuss.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-hungaria: Oxanium draws monoline strokes with no thick-thin swing, and its high x-height makes lowercase look big. Noto Sans Old Hungarian is the approachable half, its large counters staying open at tiny sizes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Distinctive, tube-like lines define Oxanium, each stroke holding a constant weight. Noto Sans Old Persian lets open counters breathe into the white space, so paragraphs feel lofty and unhurried.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tc: Oxanium looks drawn with a technical pen, steady from stem to tail. Noto Sans TC adds large open counters and curves that open outward, so the pairing's best trait is how freely both fonts breathe.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Oxanium is built monoline, with a big-looking lowercase. Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with wide channels into each counter, so paragraphs move along steadily.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-puritan: Chunky, bright, and unapologetically uniform. Oxanium is best at making lowercase look big in one steady stroke, while Puritan, with rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, does the quiet reading work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-tiktok-sans: Bold lettering with generous clearance defines Goldman, its round forms like open parentheses. TikTok Sans carries the text with an x-height rising close to cap height, leaving Goldman to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-thai: Flavors is whimsical and stubby, its curves never thinning anywhere along the stroke. Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, and that shared plumpness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Terminals cut open give Gugi counters that flow outward, and its lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed shares that height and adds a constant weight, so the two sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-armata: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals gives Paprika its presence, with letters scattered at a distance. And Armata, a sans-serif body with spacious gaps between characters, shares that openness, which is the pair's real draw.
